### New in 1.4.0
- **Home ⟷ Library Interactive Slider**: Combined the footer Home and Library tabs into an intuitive dual-slider toggle button. Slide left for Library, slide right for Home, or tap to quickly switch between your home shelf and full library.
- **Accordion Settings**: Kept all settings category headings visible with emoji badges and summaries while collapsing inner details and buttons. Tap any heading to smoothly expand its controls.
- **Reading & Finished Bookmarks**: Books currently marked as "Reading" now feature a vivid reading bookmark ribbon. When marked "Finished", the bookmark transforms into an award-style gold ribbon with a checkmark badge.
- **To-Do Due & Nearby Time Notifications**: Removed the static "Up next" list from the Home screen in favor of smart mobile alerts (scheduled 1 hour in advance and on due time, even if no explicit due date was selected) plus an in-app pop-up reminder with Skip and OK actions.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
